nodes.label: From Chatbot to Digital Colleague: The Paradigm Shift Toward Persistent Autonomous AI
nodes.author: Yongheng Zhang et al.
nodes.rationale: Surveys evolution from conversational chatbots to persistent autonomous AI along two dimensions: cognitive core (Chatbot to Thinking LLM) and tool-augmented execution (Agent to OpenClaw).

nodes.label: Chatbot Era: Fast-Response Language Generation
nodes.rationale: Characterized by scaling-driven language generation, parametric knowledge compression, behavioral alignment (RLHF), and multimodal expansion; limited by lack of intrinsic verification and self-correction.

nodes.label: Thinking LLM Era: Inference-Time Scaling and RL-Driven Reasoning
nodes.rationale: Models allocate additional inference-time compute for deliberate reasoning via long Chain-of-Thought, exploration, and reflection; enables System-2 slow thinking for mathematics, coding, planning.

nodes.label: Agent Era: Environment-Action-Feedback Loops
nodes.rationale: LLMs move from passive dialogue to active tool-calling agents; fragile due to incorrect action formats, missing observations, and unrecovered intermediate errors.

nodes.label: OpenClaw Era: Persistent Workspaces for Task Closure
nodes.rationale: Tool use embedded in persistent workspaces with files, terminals, browsers, logs, permissions, reusable skills, and verification procedures; enables context maintenance and failure recovery.

nodes.label: Workspace + Skill Paradigm
nodes.rationale: Key mechanism for Chatbot-to-Digital-Colleague transition: Workspace provides persistent state/memory/evidence; Skill provides reusable operational knowledge for task completion.

nodes.label: Data Paradigm Shift: From Instruction-Response to State-Action-Observation Trajectories
nodes.rationale: Chatbot era uses instruction-response pairs; Thinking LLM era adds Chain-of-Thought and process reward data; Agent/OpenClaw era uses state-action-observation trajectories for task-oriented learning.

nodes.label: Evaluation Paradigm Shift: From Output Scoring to Task-State Verification
nodes.rationale: Stage I: final-output accuracy; Stage II: LLM-as-judge for reasoning; Stage III: task closure rate; Stage IV: workspace capability and safety verification.

nodes.label: Long Chain-of-Thought and Inference-Time Scaling
nodes.rationale: Qualitatively different from short CoT: enables deep reasoning (tens/hundreds of steps), extensive exploration (branching alternatives), and feasible reflection (error detection/correction).

nodes.label: Reinforcement-Learning-Driven Reasoning
nodes.rationale: Models like o1 and DeepSeek-R1 use RL to internalize search, reflection, and self-correction within single output sequence; enables spontaneous interleaving of derivation, branching, and verification.

nodes.label: Open Challenges: Long-Horizon Reliability, Safety, Memory, Governance
nodes.rationale: Reasoning can remain ungrounded; long-horizon execution brittle; memory/state management transient; safety harder with executable actions; requires stronger models and better execution substrates.

nodes.label: Future Directions: Self-Evolving AI Ecosystems
nodes.rationale: From prompt engineering to harness engineering; AI-native workspaces as digital embodiment; beyond-gradient learning; composable skills and multi-agent ecosystems; continuous system maintenance.

nodes.label: From Chatbot to Digital Colleague: A Survey on Large Language Models Toward Agentic AI Systems
nodes.author: Tencent Youtu Lab
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive survey tracing evolution from chatbots to agentic AI systems through reasoning, tool use, and workspace-based task execution

nodes.label: Thinking LLM Era
nodes.rationale: Shift from single-path reasoning to deep, branching, self-correcting reasoning through RL-driven internalization

nodes.label: Agent Era
nodes.rationale: First major attempt to turn LLMs from passive conversational systems into active problem solvers through environment-action-feedback loops

nodes.label: OpenClaw Era
nodes.rationale: Agents work inside persistent workspaces with files, terminals, browsers, logs, permissions, and reusable skills for task closure

nodes.label: Workspace + Skill Paradigm
nodes.rationale: Combining reusable skills with persistent workspaces transforms LLM systems from answering models to digital workers delivering verifiable outcomes

nodes.label: Chain-of-Thought Prompting
nodes.rationale: Foundational technique showing intermediate reasoning steps improve multi-step performance

nodes.label: Tree-of-Thought
nodes.rationale: Extended CoT by allowing multiple reasoning branches and backtracking, casting planning as search problem

nodes.label: Graph-of-Thought
nodes.rationale: Generalized reasoning to arbitrary graph structures beyond linear chains

nodes.label: Self-Consistency
nodes.rationale: Improved robustness by sampling multiple reasoning paths and selecting most frequent answer through majority voting

nodes.label: RL-Driven Reasoning
nodes.rationale: Models trained with reinforcement learning spontaneously generate deep, branching, self-correcting reasoning within single output

nodes.label: OpenAI o1
nodes.rationale: Pioneering RL-driven reasoning model demonstrating internalized search and self-correction

nodes.label: DeepSeek R1
nodes.rationale: Open-source RL-driven reasoning model with long CoT distillation capabilities

nodes.label: Qwen3
nodes.rationale: Unified system with seamless thinking/non-thinking mode switching for dynamic reasoning effort allocation

nodes.label: GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization)
nodes.rationale: Removes value model from PPO, estimates advantages by comparing multiple responses, reduces memory burden

nodes.label: Process Reward Model (PRM)
nodes.rationale: Shifts supervision to individual reasoning steps rather than final answer, enabling step-level correctness judgment

nodes.label: ReAct Loop (Thought-Action-Observation)
nodes.rationale: Canonical form of agent loop interleaving reasoning and acting, distinguishing agents from chatbots

nodes.label: Agent Perception
nodes.rationale: Observing and interpreting environment; evolved from text parsing to multimodal vision-language models

nodes.label: Agent Planning
nodes.rationale: Decomposing goals and reasoning about action sequences; progressed through CoT, ToT, GoT, and RL-based methods

nodes.label: Agent Memory
nodes.rationale: Maintaining context and accumulating experience; evolved from retrieval-based to persistent experience accumulation

nodes.label: Agent Tool Use
nodes.rationale: Invoking external APIs to effect change; evolved from executable calls to API grounding at scale to trajectory-level control

nodes.label: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
nodes.rationale: Industry-wide standardization effort for how LLMs connect to external tools and data sources

nodes.label: Workspace Persistence
nodes.rationale: Durable files, terminals, browsers, repositories, logs, and execution contexts where task state persists

nodes.label: Skill Reusability
nodes.rationale: Modular, reusable units of agent capability with instructions, scripts, examples, dependencies, and checks

nodes.label: Task Closure
nodes.rationale: Delivering correct, inspectable, and recoverable final workspace state satisfying user intent

nodes.label: Delegation Pattern
nodes.rationale: User delegates bounded objective with constraints, permissions, success criteria; agent participates in shared workflow

nodes.label: State-Action-Observation Trajectory
nodes.rationale: Complete execution traces including tool outputs, UI states, workspace changes, and final-state evidence

nodes.label: Data Paradigm Shift
nodes.rationale: Evolution from static prompt-response pairs to reasoning traces to state-action-observation trajectories

nodes.label: Evaluation Paradigm Shift
nodes.rationale: From final-answer accuracy to process judgment to task closure verification

nodes.label: WebArena

nodes.label: OSWorld

nodes.label: AgentBench

nodes.label: GAIA

nodes.label: Long-Horizon Reliability

nodes.label: Safety and Governance

nodes.label: Self-Evolving AI Ecosystem

nodes.label: Harness Engineering

nodes.label: Beyond-Gradient Learning

nodes.label: Multi-Agent Orchestration

nodes.label: Digital Colleague

nodes.label: OpenClaw

nodes.label: OpenHands

nodes.label: SWE-agent

nodes.label: Voyager

nodes.label: AutoGen
nodes.rationale: Multiple agents coordinate through conversation, role specialization, and structured workflows

nodes.label: MetaGPT

nodes.label: Skill Brittleness and Environmental Drift
nodes.rationale: Skills written for particular tools, APIs, versions become invalid when conditions change; requires versioning and compatibility checks

nodes.label: Workspace Contamination and State Inconsistency
nodes.rationale: Persistent workspaces accumulate stale files, failed artifacts, obsolete logs; requires hygiene, summarization, and provenance labeling

nodes.label: Skill Supply-Chain Risk
nodes.rationale: Malicious or poorly reviewed skills may exfiltrate data, request excessive authority, or steer toward unsafe tool use

nodes.label: Human-AI Collaboration Ethics
nodes.rationale: Agents reshape professional work participation; requires preserving meaningful human agency, attribution, and accountability

nodes.label: Data Sovereignty and Privacy
nodes.rationale: Workspace agents observe sensitive data; requires tenant isolation, data minimization, purpose limitation, and provenance metadata

hyperedges.label: Two-Dimensional Evolution: Cognitive Core and Tool-Augmented Execution
hyperedges.rationale: Survey organizes LLM evolution along two tightly coupled dimensions: cognitive core (fast response to slow thinking) and tool-augmented execution (episodic agents to persistent workspaces).

hyperedges.label: Paradigm Shifts: Data, Evaluation, and Execution
hyperedges.rationale: Three interconnected shifts enable Chatbot-to-Digital-Colleague transition: data from instruction-response to state-action-observation; evaluation from output scoring to task-state verification; execution from ephemeral to persistent workspace+skill.
